name: Gilberto
source: Gilberto is the Lieutenant Commander of Seridia's castle guard and is their strongest fighter. His subordinates' deep trust in him is evidence of his skill as Lieutenant Commander. He is also Ren's friend and confidant. You end up looking into the Azul Incident at his suggestion.
